comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text:
Design recommendation for GitHub #66 image/screenshot clipboard API:

Current shape:
- `blip-clipboard` exposes `ClipboardReader::read_text() -> Result<Option<String>, ClipboardError>`, `ClipboardEvent { text }`, and a polling watcher that suppresses repeated readable text.
- `blip-daemon` maps `ClipboardEvent { text }` to `RuntimeEvent::ClipboardTextChanged { text }` and persists the existing text projection with `NewBlip { content_type: PlainText, content: text, ... }`.
- `blip-core` already has typed payload storage (`PayloadKind::Image`, `NewClipboardPayload`, `insert_blob_payload`) and ADR 0001 explicitly keeps `blips.content` as the compatibility projection.
- local `arboard` 3.6.1 supports `Clipboard::get_image()` behind `image-data`; `ImageData` is decoded RGBA pixels (`width`, `height`, `bytes`) and `arboard::Error` distinguishes `ContentNotAvailable`, `ClipboardNotSupported`, `ClipboardOccupied`, `ConversionFailure`, and `Unknown`.

Minimal API to add in `crates/blip-clipboard/src/lib.rs`:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClipboardPayloadKind { Text, Image }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ClipboardCapabilities {
    pub platform: ClipboardPlatform,
    pub supports_text: CapabilityStatus,
    pub supports_image: CapabilityStatus,
    pub preferred_image_mime_type: Option<&'static str>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CapabilityStatus {
    Supported,
    Unsupported { reason: &'static str },
    Unavailable { reason: &'static str },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ClipboardImage {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub byte_format: ImageByteFormat,
    pub mime_type: Option<&'static str>,
    pub platform_format: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ImageByteFormat { Rgba8 }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClipboardPayload {
    Text(String),
    Image(ClipboardImage),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ClipboardEvent {
    pub payload: ClipboardPayload,
}

impl ClipboardEvent {
    pub fn text(text: String) -> Self { ... }
    pub fn as_text(&self) -> Option<&str> { ... }
}

pub trait ClipboardReader {
    fn capabilities(&self) -> ClipboardCapabilities;
    fn read_payload(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ClipboardPayload>, ClipboardError>;
    fn read_text(&mut self) -> Result<Option<String>, ClipboardError> { ... } // default calls read_payload and returns text only
}
```

Keep existing text behavior by making `PollingClipboardWatcher` compare a small internal `ObservedPayloadKey` instead of only `last_text`: for text use the text value; for images use dimensions plus a cheap hash of bytes. A `None` read still resets state, so existing text tests and semantics remain intact. Keep `ClipboardEvent::text(...)` and/or `ClipboardPayload::Text` helpers so daemon test fixtures stay readable.

Typed errors:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ClipboardError {
    #[error("clipboard backend is unavailable on {platform}: {reason}")]
    Unavailable { platform: ClipboardPlatform, reason: &'static str },
    #[error("clipboard payload kind {kind:?} is unsupported on {platform}: {reason}")]
    UnsupportedPayload { platform: ClipboardPlatform, kind: ClipboardPayloadKind, reason: &'static str },
    #[error("clipboard currently has no {kind:?} payload")]
    PayloadUnavailable { kind: ClipboardPayloadKind },
    #[error("clipboard payload kind {kind:?} could not be converted on {platform}: {reason}")]
    Conversion { platform: ClipboardPlatform, kind: ClipboardPayloadKind, reason: &'static str },
    #[error("clipboard is temporarily occupied on {platform}")]
    Occupied { platform: ClipboardPlatform },
}
```

Map arboard errors as follows: `ContentNotAvailable` => `Ok(None)` when probing text/image in `read_payload`, or `PayloadUnavailable` for explicit future `read_image()` calls; `ClipboardNotSupported` => `UnsupportedPayload` or `Unavailable` depending whether `Clipboard::new()` failed versus only image fetch failed; `ClipboardOccupied` => `Occupied`; `ConversionFailure` => `Conversion`; `Unknown` => `Unavailable` for construction/read backend failures with a static local reason. Do not expose `arboard::Error` directly because it is non-exhaustive and includes developer-only descriptions.

Platform backend function:
- add an optional `arboard` dependency to `blip-clipboard` with `default-features = false` and `features = ["image-data"]`; consider enabling `wayland-data-control` under a crate feature, not by default.
- implement `PlatformClipboardReader` around `arboard::Clipboard`.
- `read_payload()` should prefer text first to preserve current behavior when both text and image alternatives exist, then try image. Screenshots/images with no text become `ClipboardPayload::Image`.
- image bytes should be RGBA8 initially. Let the daemon/blob layer decide whether to encode PNG later; do not pretend `arboard` returned PNG.

Minimal daemon bridge:

```rust
pub enum RuntimeEvent {
    Idle,
    ClipboardChanged { payload: blip_clipboard::ClipboardPayload },
    ClipboardTextChanged { text: String }, // optional compatibility variant during migration
    Shutdown,
}
```

Change `ClipboardIngestionSource` to map `event.payload` into `ClipboardChanged`. In `DaemonRuntime::run`, route `ClipboardPayload::Text(text)` to the existing `ingest_clipboard_text(text)`. For `ClipboardPayload::Image(image)`, either initially no-op with a trace/status note until blob persistence is wired, or add `ingest_clipboard_image(image)` that creates a compatibility `NewBlip` with content like `[image clipboard payload: {width}x{height} RGBA]`, `ContentType::Unknown`, tag `clipboard`, then writes a `NewClipboardPayload { kind: PayloadKind::Image, mime_type: Some("application/octet-stream" or None until encoded), platform_format: Some("rgba8"), metadata: {width,height,byte_format:"rgba8"}, bytes: image.bytes }` via `insert_blob_payload` once the runtime owns a `LocalBlobStore`. Preserve all existing text API responses by leaving `BlipDetail.content`, summaries, agent bundle text behavior unchanged.

Capability metadata exposure:
- add `ClipboardWatcher::capabilities(&self) -> ClipboardCapabilities` delegating to the reader.
- add `DaemonCommand::ClipboardRuntime` / `DaemonResponsePayload::ClipboardRuntime(ClipboardRuntimeResponse)` later, additively in API v1:

```rust
pub struct ClipboardRuntimeResponse {
    pub platform: String,
    pub text: ClipboardCapabilityDto,
    pub image: ClipboardCapabilityDto,
    pub preferred_image_mime_type: Option<String>,
    pub watcher_status: String,
}
```

This matches `docs/daemon-api.md`'s planned watcher status/capability notes without requiring clients to inspect raw clipboard state.

CI/headless safety:
- unit tests should use stub `ClipboardReader` implementations only; never instantiate `PlatformClipboardReader` except in an ignored/manual or feature-gated integration test.
- keep `system_watcher_returns_clear_platform_error` adjusted so headless Linux may return either explicit `Unavailable` or a watcher whose capabilities report unavailable image/text, but avoid requiring DISPLAY/WAYLAND.
- tests to add: `read_text_default_ignores_image_payload`, `polling_watcher_emits_image_after_text`, `polling_watcher_suppresses_duplicate_image_hash`, `polling_watcher_none_resets_image_state`, `capabilities_are_exposed_from_watcher`, `daemon_routes_text_payload_to_existing_ingestion`, `daemon_does_not_persist_image_until_blob_store_available` or `daemon_persists_image_payload_metadata` depending chosen phase.

Main risks:
- `arboard` image bytes are RGBA, so storing them raw is larger than PNG screenshots; encode before long-term blob storage if size matters.
- Linux Wayland support depends on compositor data-control support and is not enabled by arboard default features; capability metadata must say unavailable/unsupported clearly.
- Preferring text first preserves existing behavior but may hide image alternatives for apps that publish both; acceptable for minimal #66, but later rich capture may need multi-payload events.
- Windows clipboard contention is real; surface `Occupied` as transient rather than collapsing it into unavailable.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text:
Implementation review for GitHub #66:

Findings:
- Medium: Linux Wayland support is advertised but not actually enabled. Cargo.toml:26 uses arboard = "3.6.1" with default features only, and crates/blip-clipboard/Cargo.toml:9 just inherits that dependency. arboard 3.6.1 defaults to X11/XWayland on Linux; its Wayland backend requires the wayland-data-control feature. The new capability metadata at crates/blip-clipboard/src/lib.rs:269-273 reports Linux image support as available, and the unavailable reason at crates/blip-clipboard/src/lib.rs:448-449 names x11/wayland, so pure Wayland sessions will either fail at Clipboard::new()/read time or be reported as a generic unavailable environment despite issue #66 requiring Linux X11 and Wayland capability differences. Recommendation: either enable arboard's wayland-data-control feature and report compositor/data-control limitations accurately, or narrow Linux capabilities/platform_format/error text to X11/XWayland until Wayland is truly wired.

No other blocking correctness issues found in the current diff. Daemon image ingestion stores a blob payload with width/height metadata and blob refs, and the updated watcher now preserves text priority when both text and image are available.

Verification run:
- cargo test -p blip-clipboard: passed
- cargo test -p blip-daemon: passed
- cargo test -p blip-core insert_blob_payload_writes_blob_metadata_and_references: passed
- cargo check --workspace --all-targets: passed
- cargo test --workspace: passed
- cargo tree -p blip-clipboard --edges features: confirms arboard default features only; no wayland-data-control feature enabled

Did not close blip-br0.3; this is an implementation review finding, not final verification.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text: Fresh review E complete for PR #111 at c0ef2058ca11a6f07652069abcfddefe730ad4a0. No unresolved findings. The new fs2 lock is acquired around the compound blob+SQLite lifecycle operations: insert_blob_payload holds it across blob write and metadata commit; delete_blip_and_collect_orphans holds it across DB delete, remaining-reference check, and file delete; garbage_collect_blobs holds it across DB reference snapshot and blob GC. Public blob write/delete/recover/GC also serialize their filesystem mutations, and internal unlocked variants avoid reentrant lock deadlocks. I did not find an inverted lock ordering path in current blip-core call sites. Temp recovery now runs under the same lock for public recovery/write/GC, so it should not race active writers. Verification: cargo test -p blip-core blob -- --nocapture passed (14 tests); cargo test -p blip-core passed (52 tests + doctests). Merge recommendation: merge.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text: Finding: High - PR #111 still has a content-addressed blob deletion race. insert_blob_payload writes/dedupes the file before the metadata transaction commits (crates/blip-core/src/store.rs:415-424), while delete_blip_and_collect_orphans commits the row deletion, checks only committed refs, then deletes the shared file (crates/blip-core/src/store.rs:498-510). Interleaving: writer B dedupes against blob X but has not committed its payload row; deleter A removes the last committed ref, sees no committed refs for X, and deletes X; B then commits metadata pointing at a missing blob. The same stale-snapshot problem applies to garbage_collect deleting refs absent from the caller-provided set (crates/blip-core/src/blob.rs:178-187) while a concurrent writer has already deduped the file but not committed metadata. This can create durable DB references to deleted blob files after the race fixes.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text:
Fresh review B findings for PR #111:

High: crates/blip-core/src/blob.rs:55-83 runs recover() at the start of every LocalBlobStore::write(), and recover() unconditionally removes every file in the shared tmp directory. With two writers using the same blob store, one writer can delete another writer's just-created temp file before hard_link publishes it, causing a spurious write failure and violating the atomic-from-caller write guarantee. Recovery should only clean stale/non-owned temp files, or run under store-level coordination, rather than clearing all tmp files on each write.

High: crates/blip-core/src/store.rs:423-429 has a TOCTOU data-loss race in metadata rollback cleanup. After a failed metadata insert, it checks whether the content-addressed blob_ref is referenced and then deletes it, but no DB/file lock protects the interval between the SELECT and delete. Another process can commit a payload row for the same deduped blob_ref after the check and before delete, leaving that row pointing at a missing blob. Immediate rollback cleanup needs coordination/proof of ownership, or should defer physical deletion to a coordinated GC pass.

Verification run: gh pr view 111 --json ...; gh pr diff 111 --color=never; gh issue view 65 --json title,body,state; cargo test -p blip-core blob -- --nocapture (passed, 13 tests); cargo check -p blip-core (passed). Also attempted a multi-filter cargo test invocation, but cargo accepts only one TESTNAME and rejected the command before running tests.

Recommendation: do not merge until these lifecycle races are fixed or explicitly scoped to a single-writer store with enforcement.

comments.text: Explorer starting: inspect SQLite payload metadata integration for blob lifecycle.

comments.author: Adrian Cosentino
comments.text: Findings: typed payload schema already has nullable blip_payloads.blob_ref plus content_hash/byte_size/metadata, FK cascade from blips, and store decoding via ClipboardPayload. Minimal schema addition recommended: index blip_payloads(blob_ref) WHERE blob_ref IS NOT NULL for referenced-ref enumeration/shared-ref checks; no separate blob table needed unless future blob inventory/audit requires it. Integration gaps: LocalBlobStore is not exported from blip-core lib.rs and currently relies on BlipError variants/io conversion not present in error.rs, so wiring it in must first add pub mod blob and blob errors. Store APIs needed: NewClipboardPayload input; insert_blip_with_payloads/write flow that writes blobs first then inserts blip + payload rows in one SQLite tx, with cleanup of newly written unreferenced blob refs on DB failure; referenced_blob_refs() -> HashSet<String>; delete_blip_and_collect_orphans/delete_payload_and_collect_orphans that snapshots blob refs, deletes SQLite rows, commits, then deletes only refs no longer present in blip_payloads. Avoid direct LocalBlobStore::delete during row deletion; prefer LocalBlobStore::garbage_collect(&store.referenced_blob_refs()?) for crash-safe cleanup. Tests needed: binary payload insert stores blob metadata; DB rollback removes newly unique blob but not preexisting dedup blob; delete one of two payloads sharing blob keeps file; delete last ref removes file; referenced_blob_refs returns distinct non-null refs; FK cascade deletes payload metadata before orphan cleanup; GC keeps referenced and removes orphan files.
